ideas.title: The Festive Dining Experience
ideas.trend: Celebratory festive thali presentation reels featuring traditional festive background music and family dining ambience.
ideas.hook: An evening designed for true celebration.
ideas.captionStarter: Gather your loved ones tonight for an authentic dining experience with our Festive Thali at ₹499, served with a complimentary handcrafted dessert.
plan: 0–2s: Wide panning shot of an elegant dinner table dressed in maroon and gold linens with the new leaf logo subtly etched on the brass tableware.
2–4s: Smooth top-down view of the real, freshly prepared Festive Thali placed gracefully on the table.
4–6s: Warm, close-up shot of the complimentary dessert being served beside the thali under warm ambient lighting.
6–8s: Final frame highlighting the curated table setting with warm gold accents and on-screen text inviting guests for dinner.
ideas.postWhen: Post at 7:00 PM as specified in memory for when regulars are online.
ideas.whyItFits: The client asked to highlight the Festive Thali at ₹499 in every post and provide free dessert with every thali. This elegant reel embraces their required maroon and gold palette while keeping a sophisticated tone.

ideas.title: Heritage on a Plate

ideas.hook: A closer look into timeless tradition.
ideas.captionStarter: Explore the balanced heritage recipes that complete our Festive Thali at ₹499, served alongside a complimentary dessert.
plan: Slide 1: High-resolution cover photo of the complete Festive Thali on a maroon background with elegant gold serif typography and the leaf logo.
Slide 2: Crisp close-up of the fragrant spiced curries and slow-simmered lentils with a brief note on traditional spices.
Slide 3: Close-up of hot artisan flatbreads and fragrant steamed basmati rice.
Slide 4: Feature of the complimentary artisanal dessert included with every thali.
Slide 5: Final slide in maroon and gold detailing the Festive Thali at ₹499, with a refined call to join us for dinner tonight.
